title: Creating directories safely
hints: os.Mkdir creates exactly one directory: it fails when the parent is missing, and when the directory already exists. os.MkdirAll creates every missing parent and succeeds if the directory is already there.
The relative paths come from outside, so check each one before using it: "../escape" or an absolute path would create directories outside root.
filepath.IsLocal(rel) is true only for a non-empty relative path that stays inside the current directory. Return an error when it's false.
